title: From Physical Information Systems to Digital Public Knowledge
centralQuestion: How can the distinctive intelligence embedded in the card catalogue and manual telephone switchboard be transgressed into digital interfaces that rethink indexing and community in the age of AI?

epistemicPolicy.note: References and reported historical facts are transcribed/synthesized from user-provided research; their verification has not been independently performed in this ingestion. This is not a benchmark or user study.
epistemicPolicy.syntaxCaveat: The report questions verification of the exact Syntax passage; this conflicts with earlier conversation-level transcript attribution. Verify timestamp and wording against the primary transcript before public quotation.

thesis.index: A catalogue exposes previous descriptive labour, access routes, omissions, and review authority.
thesis.community: A switchboard exposes the establishment, supervision, and release of mediated connections, not a persistent message archive.
thesis.convergence: A temporary problem desk can keep source records, classification claims, and conversational relations separate and inspectable.

convergence.name: The Problem Desk
convergence.coreAction: Propose an index correction from an independent contribution, preview changed retrieval, preserve unchanged original source and separate acceptance from proposal.
convergence.workedExample: A symptom classified as cache invalidation is challenged as authentication-state mismatch for a bounded version range; compare old and proposed retrieval.
boundaries: No source mutation by local view changes
Do not force convergence if editorial comprehension suffers

rules: Use typography and metadata to distinguish source speech from classification and interpretation.
Blue for established reference structure, violet for proposed relations, rose for contested claims; never color-only status.
Motion follows meaningful state changes; reduced motion retains meaning.
Avoid fake verification stamps, decorative distress, fake handwriting, ornamental Japanese characters, and retro furniture imitation.

evaluation.method: Compare comprehension with simpler conventional alternatives; separate mechanism comprehension from retrieval quality and enjoyment.
